opening.argument: The presentation promotes Forsage BUSD as an income opportunity built on recruitment, team-building, and participant contributions. It plainly describes the business as requiring referrals and recruiting people, instructs viewers to convert strangers into downlines, and offers access to a marketing funnel once they join the team. It further says digital-asset contributions go indirectly to other people and that rewards result from the efforts of many participants, before inviting viewers to sign up. Those features establish a contribution-linked, recruitment-based return opportunity, even though the speaker acknowledges effort and advises due diligence.
